---
name: '🚀 Feature request'
about: Suggest an idea, architectural enhancement, or new feature for express-sentinel-limiter
title: '[FEAT] '
labels: ['enhancement']
assignees: ''

---

> [!TIP]
> Before proposing a new feature, please check existing [Issues](https://github.com/rayrishu19-wq/express-sentinel-limiter/issues) and review our [Contributing Guidelines](https://github.com/rayrishu19-wq/express-sentinel-limiter/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

### 💡 Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? Please describe.
A clear and concise description of what the problem or limitation is. *(e.g. "I need to support dynamically adjusting refill rates based on user tier...")*

### ✨ Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Explain how this enhancement fits into the token-bucket algorithm or Redis store.

### 💻 Proposed API / Usage Example
Provide a conceptual example of how developers would use this new capability:
```javascript
const limiter = createSentinelLimiter({
  // Your proposed option or API signature here
});
```

### 🔍 Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative designs, workaround libraries, or approaches you've evaluated.

### 🎯 Target Use Cases
Who will benefit from this feature and in what scenarios (e.g. high-throughput microservices, multi-tenant SaaS, WebSocket auth)?

### 📎 Additional Context
Add any other context, relevant RFC specifications, benchmarks, or links here.
